_comment: Canonical label taxonomy for the leaf disease model. 'canonical_labels' is the exact 38-class vocabulary extracted from the currently deployed MLModel1.mlnet - do not rename these or the existing model's classes will no longer line up with a fine-tuned successor. Add new canonical labels at the bottom of the list when you bring in a crop/disease that isn't covered yet.

sources.name: new_plant_diseases_dataset
sources._comment: The dataset the current model was already trained on. Point this at wherever you re-download/keep it; folder names already match canonical_labels exactly, so no mapping is needed.

sources.name: EXAMPLE_new_source
sources._comment: Template for a new dataset (e.g. PlantDoc, PlantSeg, a cassava/rice/coffee dataset). Run `python prepare_dataset.py discover --source <path>` first to list its actual leaf folder names, then fill in 'mapping' below: source folder name -> canonical label. Map to a brand-new label (not in canonical_labels above) to introduce a new class - add it to canonical_labels too. Any source folder you don't map is copied into <out>/_unmapped/<name>/ instead of being silently dropped or guessed.
